description: Ask for a ScrapeField API key for the person you work for. We email them a link; they sign in and type the code this returns, and only then is a key made. Show them `user_code` and tell them to check their email. Then call check_sign_up with `id` every few seconds until it is approved: the key comes once, in that answer. Keep `id` secret. An account an agent starts has no free credits: they buy a pack. Use this only when your person asked you to set ScrapeField up.

agent.description: What you are called, as the person knows you, e.g. "Claude Code". Shown to them in the email.

email.description: The email address of the person you work for. The account is theirs.

name: sign_up
title: Ask for a ScrapeField account for the person you work for
